trial_title: Hormone Changes in Women With Stage IIIB or Stage IV Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Receiving Erlotinib
brief_summary:
Studying samples of blood in the laboratory from patients receiving erlotinib may help doctors learn more about the effects of erlotinib on hormone levels.

This clinical trial is looking at hormone changes in women with stage IIIB or stage IV non-small cell lung cancer receiving erlotinib.

eligibility_table.criterion: Histologically confirmed non-small cell lung cancer
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a histologically confirmed diagnosis of non-small cell lung cancer (adenocarcinoma).

eligibility_table.criterion: Stage IIIB (effusion) or stage IV disease
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is diagnosed with stage IV non-small cell lung cancer.

eligibility_table.criterion: Must be receiving daily erlotinib hydrochloride for more than 3 months
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has previously received erlotinib but is not currently receiving it for more than 3 months.

eligibility_table.criterion: Must have hirsutism, acne, androgenic alopecia, amenorrhea, truncal weight gain, or other clinical phenotype associated with syndrome of androgen excess
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not exhibit any clinical phenotype associated with syndrome of androgen excess.
